biotools.summary: TopicVelo is a tool that disentangles simultaneous, yet distinct, bursty transcriptional dynamics using a probabilistic topic model for RNA velocity estimation in single-cell RNA-sequencing data. It enables more accurate velocity estimation by integrating process-specific signals.
